title: dianthus pyrenaicus subsp. costae
intro: Dianthus pyrenaicus subsp. costae, commonly known as Pyrenean pink or Costae's pink, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the carnation family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to calm the nervous system and exert a sedative effect, making it a potential natural remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Dianthus pyrenaicus subsp. costae include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
